summary: Controlled RGB ordinary diagnostic reproduces the original terminal F pool_score rejection as a finite present-but-zero gradient. The actual scorer emits FP16 logits from nonidentical FP32 projected relation directions. Matched real scaled-full-backward events have native weight-gradient nnz [0,3,0], while same-Z/same-underlying-weight/same-real-pooled-upstream detached FP32 local VJPs are finite and nonzero in all512 components on all three attempts.
